title: CardMesh
summary: Your pocket console for the mesh.
description:
CardMesh is a keyboard-first pocket client for MeshMonitor, Meshtastic, and MeshCore, built for the M5Stack CardputerZero -- the first CardputerZero client targeting all three.

This release (v0.1.0) ships the MeshMonitor-based Dashboard, an offline-capable OpenStreetMap node-position Map screen, and a GitHub Releases-based self-updater (check/install with one key). Direct Meshtastic/MeshCore support via the CardputerZero's onboard LoRa hat is planned, not yet implemented -- see the project README for the full roadmap.

Not yet verified on real CardputerZero hardware or the official online emulator.
